searchText: How much more quickly, if at all, could we do an upgrade that _only_ provided for withdrawals? This year? Even if we want to do that, I don’t think any of the other included EIPs meaningfully changes implementation complexity? I do think it’s hard to imagine shipping something on mainnet this year when we have basically 7 weeks until the Christmas holidays, and implementations haven’t started for everyone. Yeah, a Happy New Year is wishful thinking. But only EIP-3855: PUSH0 instruction is merged on all clients, so I wondered about the others.
